Subject: QBR packet: Quantif account summaries + risk tagging

Team —

We need a short, tight packet on Quantif for the QBR next week. Ask is below; please reply with assigned owner and ETA by end of day Tuesday (2027-09-14).

What I need (single-slide, 1 page each account):
- Executive summary (one sentence on health and topline forecast movement)
- Consolidated 90/60/30-day forecast (include commit probability and expected close month)
- Top 3 risks (impact + mitigation)
- Recent CS / support touchpoints and any action items
- Any outstanding procurement/contract asks from the customer

Attachments: account_summary_template.xlsx (xlsx) — use this template; pipeline_extract.csv (csv) — last export from Sales Ops.

Initial owner suggestions: Laura — Quantif account summary + customer health; Rishi — pricing/terms questions and any redlines; Monica — CS notes and risk mitigations. Markus/Vivek: please confirm.

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, North America Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-09-13T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR packet: Quantif account summaries + risk tagging

Agree with assignment. Quick notes on forecast consolidation process — please follow this order and populate the attached consolidated file: forecast_consol_v0.3.csv

1) Pull closed-won history and current open pipeline from pipeline_extract.csv.
2) For each opportunity, record: ARR estimate, close month, current stage, forecast confidence (0.0-1.0), owner notes on gating items.
3) Flag any revenue that has legal/procurement blockers as "Procurement Risk" and call out the expected hold duration.
4) Provide a best-case / base-case / downside for the quarter (numbers + short rationale).

Laura: you'll own the exec summary slide and the final consolidated numbers.
Rishi: please draft a short note on contract amendments — Quantif historically asks for extended data retention and specific logging SLA language; capture likely redlines and approximate turnaround time for Legal.
Rachel (cc): can you pull the latest HubSpot opportunity timeline into the consol file and drop the link into the QBR Drive folder?

Let's keep slides to 6 pages max. If external procurement questions are unresolved by EOD Wednesday, indicate that as a QBR talking point.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Commercial Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: forecast_consol_v0.3.csv (csv)

- Updated timing: our internal budget committee pushed expected close from Oct -> Nov (shift by one month); range still looks like $420k–$520k ARR depending on approvals.
- Procurement: procurement@quantif.ai has two asks: 1) add a 12-month data retention option to Schedule A; 2) add SOC 2 attestation clause with a 30-day remediation SLA. They copied legal on a separate thread.
- Technical: our SRE wants clarity on KV cache behavior under burst loads; they requested a short tech one-pager or architectural note.
